name: SensorCommunityNoiseReading
description: One telemetry reading from a Sensor.Community citizen node that carries a noise sensor, transcribed from the io.sensor.community SensorReading event of the real-time-sources feeder. The sample exists because the three sound levels the node reports are all in decibels and all A-weighted, and a decibel figure means nothing until the weighting it was taken under and the reference it stands against are stated: an A-weighted level and an unweighted level over the same sound are different numbers, and a level relative to twenty micropascals and a level relative to digital full scale are different numbers again. It demonstrates `measurementConditioning` attaching to each acoustic value to carry the A-weighting and the sound-pressure reference the feed documents but the numbers do not, and it demonstrates that the keyword attaches only to the conditioned measurements: the particulate and temperature channels in the same record carry a unit and no conditioning, because there is nothing hidden in them to state. The feed names the weighting but not the time constant, so `timeWeighting` is omitted rather than guessed, and the two extrema are additionally marked as the `minimum` and `maximum` statistics they are.

sensor_id.description: Stable integer identifier of the Sensor.Community node, from the `sensor_id` field. The node is the feature the reading is about.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp the node published for the reading, from the `timestamp` field, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` form.

noise_laeq_db.description: Equivalent continuous sound level over the reporting interval, from the `noise_laeq_db` field. LAeq is A-weighted and energy-averaged, so it carries a frequency weighting but no single time constant.

noise_la_min_db.description: Minimum A-weighted sound level over the interval, from the `noise_la_min_db` field.

noise_la_max_db.description: Maximum A-weighted sound level over the interval, from the `noise_la_max_db` field.

pm2_5_ug_m3.description: Particulate-matter mass concentration for PM2.5, from the `pm2_5_ug_m3` field. It carries a unit and no conditioning: unlike a sound level, the number is complete once the unit is known.

temperature_celsius.description: Ambient temperature, from the `temperature_celsius` field. Carried here to show a value that needs no measurement conditioning beside the ones that do.
